recovery.title: Recover Account
recovery.subtitle: Enter the email associated with your TapTrade account and we will send you a secure link to create a new password.

recovery.link_valid_notice: The link is valid for 60 minutes for security.

recovery.err_generic: An unexpected error occurred while requesting the reset.
recovery.hero_title: Your collection and data always protected.
recovery.hero_desc: At TapTrade we apply rigorous digital security standards. The recovery process generates ephemeral single-use links ensuring only you can reset access to your account.
recovery.crypto_desc: Your passwords are protected with bcrypt hashing and recovery tokens expire in 60 minutes.
recovery.vault_safe_desc: Your purchases, sales, history and collectible cards remain fully safe at all times.
recovery.meta_description: Recover access to your TapTrade account. Reset your password securely and protect your collection.
